# Exchange files (made up)

Sample files for the importer for any exchange's CSV (B5b, #567): one for each
ready-made mapping, each written in its exchange's published format (header,
dates, numbers and kinds of row, from the exchange's help pages and open-source
parsers) with **made-up rows only**. None comes from anyone's real export: this
repository is public. `backend/tests/test_exchange_import_567_mappings.py` works
out each file's figures by hand and checks the import against them.

Owner: the BitcoinTX project (DigiMonk73/BTCTX-MCP); kept by Claude.
